name: The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas

address.street: One Ocean Drive Paradise Island Nassau N.P

insider_take: This legendary resort sits on Paradise Island's most pristine stretch of beach, where old-world Bahamian elegance meets Four Seasons luxury on the very grounds where James Bond's Casino Royale was filmed.
whats_special: The resort's stunning Versailles Gardens feature cascading terraces, imported French sculptures, and a 14th-century Augustinian cloister stone by stone from France. The property spans both oceanfront and harborside locations connected by a graceful arched bridge, offering guests dual coastal experiences.
pro_tip: Book the Crescent Beach villa section for ultimate privacy and direct beach access – it's where A-listers stay and features the same powdery white sand beach seen in the Bond film.
dont_miss: Sunset cocktails at the Dune Bar with unobstructed views of Nassau Harbor, and a morning stroll through the meticulously maintained gardens ending at the clifftop Temple – perfect for that Instagram-worthy shot overlooking turquoise waters.
pros: Pristine private beaches with crystal-clear turquoise waters
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Stunning colonial-style architecture and lush tropical gardens
World-class spa and championship golf course on-site
cons: Remote Paradise Island location requires planned transportation
